Each annotation contains original native x/y, uncertainty box/region chosen from before evidence, visible adjacent part-line descriptions, target identity, alternative interpretation. Native8 remains UNKNOWN. No 3D snapping, coordinate-to-model fit or GT proximity selection.

Root reads both sealed before reviews and freezes a union of proposals with reviewer identity and uncertainty. No after-guided location/cue corrections. Duplicates may be linked but original points/regions preserved.

Only after root reference union seal, inspect corresponding after raw RGB at unchanged reference/region plus full context. Independently record visible cue, verified separate foreground blocker covering cue, partial/unclear, or movement/registration ambiguity.
